decisionsTitle: A «Regrupare» checkpoint: the group waits here, the point's note says how long, and its glyph comes first on a pin (amending §757, §770 and §802)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-19:** «Vreau un tip de punct de control de tipul „regrupare"; va fi foarte util pentru alergările de grup.» A group run is where the club's runners go together, and the point where the front of the group waits for the back is the one thing its route has that a race's does not. §757 gave a checkpoint what it offers a runner (water, food, first aid, timing) and §770 added the person who shows the way; none of them says «we wait here».

**A sixth kind, «Regrupare» / "Regroup".** `REGROUP` joins the enum `event_checkpoint_kind` (migration `0174_checkpoint_regroup`, expand only: one `ALTER TYPE … ADD VALUE`, in a file of its own because PostgreSQL refuses to use a new value in the transaction that adds it) and `CHECKPOINT_KINDS`, **last**, so the five before it keep their places in the editor's row of ticks and in every saved list. **No new field:** how long the group waits is the point's own note, which already exists in both languages — the editor's kinds row carries one «?» that says so («Regrupare: grupul se așteaptă aici. Scrie în notă cât timp (de ex. „așteptăm 5 minute")»), and the event page prints the note on the point's row as it prints any other.

**The glyph is the group of people** — Material's `Groups`, the one the «other event» type already wears (a meeting of people) — in the page table's chip (`CHECKPOINT_GLYPH`, one glyph per kind), now beside each kind's word in the editor's ticks too, and **drawn as a path of its own** on the elevation pins (`routes/elevation/glyphs.ts`, three heads and shoulders in the 16 × 16 box: the pins are SVG path data, never a MUI icon inside an SVG, and the race number's strip and its PDF walk the same data). The group's two side figures are drawn shorter than the middle one so that no corner leaves the pin's ring (every glyph's outline stays within 8.1 of its centre, the drop's round bulb 8.2; a test walks the paths, arcs included). On a group run's page the same `Groups` picture also draws «Vin (N)» and the start list: on purpose, all of them mean «the group», and each stands beside its own word.

**The pin's priority: «Regrupare» first, in both orders.** `glyphForKinds` picks one glyph for a point with several kinds; a point where the group waits says so before anything it also offers, so `REGROUP` heads the race number's order (water, food, first aid, timing, direction) and the page's food-before-water order (§807) alike. On the race number a regroup point within a pin's reach of an aid station gives way to it (§757's older rule between two points that would touch stays: the aid station wins), while one point that is both keeps the group's glyph. A point with water and a regroup pins the group; the table still lists both chips, and the race number's label still says «km 6 · apă» (the words say what a runner may take). **The race number's drawing is unchanged:** no stored checkpoint has the kind, every set of the five earlier kinds pins exactly the glyph it pinned (a test walks all thirty-two), their paths are pinned by a test, and `BIB_DRAWING_VERSION` stays 4 — a point the club gives the new kind changes its own picture address through the checkpoints' stamp, which already carries the kinds.

**The GPX guess learns the words.** A waypoint whose name says «regrupare», «regrupăm», «regroup…», «regroupement», «adunare», «ne adunăm», «așteptăm» or «waiting for» is offered as «Regrupare» (accent-insensitive like the others, whole words only: «așteptare» alone is a queue, «waiting room» a room, «regrupez» not a word it knows). The event's JSON file needs no new version: `kinds` is validated against the same list, so a file with the kind round-trips and a file made before it reads as it did; an older platform reading a newer file leaves the kind out with its word, as §770 decided for unknown kinds.

**Refused:** a field for the minutes («Așteptăm … minute») — the note is where the club already writes anything about a point, in both languages, and a number would be a second place to keep in step with it; a glyph that depends on the event's type (the card is offered on every event, and a race may regroup too); drawing the group on the race number with a version bump now (nothing stored changes its picture); making the kind exclusive of the others (a water point where the group waits is both); an automatic cut-off or a delay for the point (a regroup is a pause, not a gate: the time limit stays the runner's, §770).

**The chain:** the migration is `0174` at journal position 169, stacked on `0173_rsvp_ask_settings` (`feat/rsvp-ask-settings`) only for its number; the snapshot follows `0173`'s and differs in this value alone. If that lane regenerates `0173`, the batch re-checks the chain — `tests/integration/db/checkpoint-regroup-migration.test.ts` fails when this snapshot's `prevId` is not the previous one's `id`.
changelogLine: - **A «Regrupare» checkpoint** — a sixth kind for the point where the group waits, with the group-of-people glyph on the page's table, in the editor's ticks, on the profile's pins (first, before water or food) and on the race number; its note says how long, and a GPX waypoint named «regrupare», «adunare» or «așteptăm» is offered as one. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criteria 77 and 82. A point's kinds on the event page may include «Regrupare» / "Regroup", a chip with the group-of-people glyph and its word, one glyph per kind, and the point's note — where the club writes how long the group waits — is printed on its row like any other; the profile's pin for a point that has it draws the group before the glyph of anything else the point offers, on the page's order and the race number's alike (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 97. The race number's strip pins a «Regrupare» point with the group-of-people glyph from the shared elevation core, before the glyph of any other kind the point has, and labels it «km 12» (an aid station's words still win: «km 6 · apă»); the glyph and the label of every set of the five earlier kinds are exactly what they were, and the picture's drawing version is unchanged (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 123 and 153. In the editor's card «Puncte de control» the row «Ce găsești aici» has a sixth tick, «Regrupare» / "Regroup", last, each tick wearing its kind's glyph, and one «?» that says the group waits here and the wait is written in the note; the kind is saved with the others in the closed set's order, read back and audited as any change; `event_checkpoint_kind` has the value `REGROUP` after `DIRECTION` (migration `0174`, expand only), every point written before it unchanged; a GPX waypoint whose words say «regrupare», «adunare», «ne adunăm», «așteptăm» or «waiting for» is offered as «Regrupare»; and the event's JSON file carries the kind and round-trips it (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
